root_cause.text: In `wpcm_fiu_probe()` of the `spi-wpcm-fiu` driver, the code used the `res` pointer returned by `platform_get_resource_byname()` in `resource_size(res)` without first validating that `res` was non-NULL, leading to a NULL dereference when the `"memory"` resource is absent.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states "`platform_get_resource_byname() can return NULL, which would cause a crash when passed the pointer to resource_size()`", and the patch moves `fiu->memory_size = min_t(size_t, resource_size(res), MAX_MEMORY_SIZE_TOTAL);` from before the `IS_ERR(fiu->memory)` check to after it, so `resource_size(res)` is no longer reached before resource validation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Initialize memory_size only after successful flash memory mapping to keep probe setup consistent and avoid size assignment on failed mapping.
intent_record.what: The assignment of fiu->memory_size = min_t(size_t, resource_size(res), MAX_MEMORY_SIZE_TOTAL); was moved from immediately after devm_ioremap_resource(dev, res) to after the IS_ERR(fiu->memory) error check, with no other code changes.
intent_record.how: At runtime, this ensures memory_size is only computed after confirming the flash memory window mapping succeeded, avoiding use of the resource-derived size in a path where the mapping result is an error and keeping initialization ordered around successful resource setup.

This statement also uses res before any explicit NULL validation. While the crash root cause is specifically the later resource_size(res) call, this line is part of the same unsafe use of the possibly NULL resource pointer.

If platform_get_resource_byname() failed to find the "memory" resource, res would be NULL and this line would trigger the NULL dereference described in the root cause.

bic_trace_step.reason: The snippet is sufficient because it shows the exact logic added in `wpcm_fiu_probe()` around the `memory` resource handling. The vulnerable construct is present: `res = platform_get_resource_byname(pdev, IORESOURCE_MEM, "memory");` is followed immediately by `fiu->memory = devm_ioremap_resource(dev, res);` and `fiu->memory_size = min_t(size_t, resource_size(res), MAX_MEMORY_SIZE_TOTAL);` with no prior `if (!res)` check. This means `resource_size(res)` will dereference `res` even when `platform_get_resource_byname()` returned NULL because the "memory" resource is absent, matching the described root cause. The only check present is `if (IS_ERR(fiu->memory))`, which happens after both uses of `res` and does not protect against `res == NULL`. Therefore the bug is present and the fix is not yet included.
